projects.title: Agentic AI Machine Learning Pipeline for Big Data Analytics
projects.body: An end-to-end agentic AI pipeline using LangGraph and PySpark to automate data analysis, feature engineering, and model training. Implemented with human-in-the-loop review gates and automated quality checks.

projects.title: Twitter Bot Detection Model
projects.body: A Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN) developed from a heterogeneous user-to-user graph constructed from a representative subgraph of 40k users and engineered relation types from raw Twitter interaction data.

projects.title: TikTok TechJam 2026
projects.body: A conversational AI shopping assistant combining keyword and semantic search, cross-encoder reranking, and weighted entropy to personalise recommendations and guide follow-up questions across a catalogue of 50,000 products.

projects.title: Terminal CV
projects.body: An interactive portfolio built with Vue and Vite, recreating a Windows command prompt with simulated Git commands, clickable files, persistent themes, and automated deployment through GitHub Pages.

projects.title: NUS SDSS Datathon 2026
projects.body: A prototype analytics pipeline using K-means and hierarchical clustering to segment applicants, analyse employer attractiveness survey responses, and generate LLM summaries to inform employer branding and survey design.
